title: Penthouse November 1985 Carina Ragnarsson Alfred Regnery Complete w/ Centerfold
conditionDescription: Complete w/ centerfold. Covers clean and bright with light handling wear; spine intact. See photos.
descriptionText:
Penthouse magazine, November 1985, original $3.50 cover price. Complete w/ Centerfold. Pet: Carina Ragnarsson.

Cover features: Medical genocide - the American medical establishment's holy war on progress; Alfred Regnery and the Reagan administration fiasco.

Back cover: Lucky Strike Lights cigarette ad.

Adult collectible - sold to buyers 18+ only. See photos for condition. Ships in a plain, protective mailer.
